"DRIZZIES

An 87 Production Studio Original Game

Create a fully playable, retro pixel-art mobile virtual pet game called DRIZZIES, inspired by Tamagotchi. Use the provided black-and-white dinosaur image as the visual reference. Design for vertical 9:16 touchscreen gameplay with animated monsters, retro 8-bit music, sound effects, and interactive environments.

THIS MUST BE A FUNCTIONAL GAME, NOT A MOCKUP. EVERY BUTTON AND FEATURE MUST WORK.

MONSTER LIFE CYCLE

Players hatch a Drizzy from an egg and raise it through four stages: Egg, Baby, Child, and Teen, followed by adulthood. Drizzies grow through real-world time and player care.

DAILY CARE

Players must feed, bathe, play with, pet, train, medicate, and put their Drizzies to sleep. Track hunger, happiness, hygiene, energy, health, affection, strength, intelligence, and agility. Monsters react with unique animations and sounds.

PERMANENT DEATH

Drizzies can permanently die from starvation, sickness, neglect, exhaustion, or old age. Their needs continue changing while the game is closed. Include health warnings, death animations, and a graveyard recording each deceased Drizzy's name, age, evolution, and cause of death.

EVOLUTIONS

Adult Drizzies evolve into King, Beast, Shadow, Cyber, Angel, Chaos, Legendary, or secret forms. Evolution depends on genetics, personality, training, and care. Each form has unique sprites and abilities.

BREEDING AND GENETICS

Players can own multiple Drizzies and breed two compatible adults they own. No multiplayer required. Babies inherit colors, horns, eyes, tails, abilities, personalities, and rare mutations. Include egg incubation, a nursery, generation tracking, breeding compatibility, and a permanent family tree. Prevent close-relative breeding.

CUSTOMIZATION

Allow players to name their Drizzies and customize body colors, eyes, horns, tails, clothing, hats, necklaces, and accessories. Changes must appear on the monster.

ACTIVITIES AND ECONOMY

Include playable jumping, racing, memory, food-catching, and treasure-hunting minigames. Earn coins to purchase food, medicine, soap, toys, outfits, furniture, and habitat upgrades.

HABITATS

Create customizable pixel environments including forests, caves, deserts, mountains, castles, haunted areas, and futuristic cities. Allow players to manage multiple Drizzies with independent needs.

PERSONALITIES

Drizzies develop unique personalities including playful, lazy, brave, shy, stubborn, affectionate, and rebellious. Animate eating, sleeping, crying, laughing, sickness, playing, breeding, and evolving.

SAVE GAME SYSTEM

Include a fully functional SAVE GAME button prominently displayed on the main screen and in the pause menu.

- SAVE GAME manually saves all progress immediately.
- AUTO SAVE saves after important actions and at regular intervals.
- CONTINUE GAME loads the most recent saved progress.
- Save all monsters, names, stats, ages, evolutions, genetics, generations, inventory, coins, habitats, achievements, and graveyard records.
- Use persistent local storage so progress remains after closing or restarting the game.
- Display GAME SAVED SUCCESSFULLY after manual saves.
- Never reset player progress unless the player explicitly chooses New Game and confirms.
- Calculate elapsed real-world time when reopening the game, including hunger, aging, illness, and possible death.

MAIN MENU

Include functional buttons for:

NEW GAME | CONTINUE | SAVE GAME | MY DRIZZIES | NURSERY | BREEDING | MARKET | ARCADE | FAMILY TREE | GRAVEYARD | SETTINGS

SOUND AND GRAPHICS

Use animated black-and-white pixel monsters, unlockable colors, original 8-bit music, cute creature sounds, eating noises, splashing water, egg cracking, evolution effects, and retro button clicks.

FINAL REQUIREMENTS

Make DRIZZIES a complete, playable, mobile-friendly virtual pet simulator with real-time care, permanent death, branching evolution, breeding, genetics, customization, working minigames, and reliable manual and automatic saving.

Every menu, purchase, interaction, and button must function. Prioritize working gameplay over decorative screens. Build a playable core first and expand without breaking existing features.

DRIZZIES
Hatch Them. Raise Them. Evolve Them. Love Them.

87 PRODUCTION STUDIO PRESENTS

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
